messages:
alice: RFC follow-up on rollout controls for kernel-selection + attention optimizations. Quick sync: RFC#1287 landed most pieces but we still need a safe operator path for per-model flags, a deterministic fallback policy, and the rollout schema. Goal: ship a minimally viable rollout control by EOW.
ben: agree we should avoid a single global toggle. per-model flags with inheritance from org/team makes sense. +1 for operator override (force on/force off). :+1:
carla: can we codify rollout as: percent/ramp/window + rollback_on thresholds? also need an explicit canary path that pins nodes.
devops-bot: deploy started for service/flag-store v2 -> sha: a1b2c3. Canary cluster: runtime-canary-us-west
dave: telemetry question — what SLOs trigger automated rollback? p95 latency? error-rate? quality regressions are tricky to detect automatically. link to dashboards: https://dash.redwood/ops/rollouts :eyes:
erin: add a circuit-breaker that trips if p99 token latency > X or token-error-rate > Y. Also admin UI needs a one-click kill switch per-model and per-org. audit logs must capture who flipped what.
frank: storing flags: options are config-service (postgres-backed), runtime-kv (redis), or baked into deployment config. My vote: config-service for persistence + runtime-kv for fast reads. fallbacks: store fallback order in config too.
grace: fallback order proposal: [preferred-optimized-kernel, quantized-compat-kernel, legacy-kernel, local-fallback-lm]. if none available, route to hosted-fallback with degraded quota. also include per-model override for sequence-length heuristics.
alice: concrete metrics to monitor: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost delta, and eval-set regression alerts (we already have eval hooks). Rollout schema should include: model_id, flag_id, percent, ramp_minutes, pinned_nodes, fallback_policy (ordered list), rollback_conditions (list of metric thresholds), owner, audit_info.
ben: sample rollout snippet:```json
{"model_id":"gptx-1","flag":"attention-opt-v2","percent":10,"ramp_minutes":30,"pinned_nodes":"canary-1","rollback_conditions":{"p95_ms":">100","error_rate_pct":">0.5"}}
```
carla: question on gating by sequence length distribution — some customers have long tails. we should allow gating by a selector: e.g., seq_len>2048 -> skip optimized kernel.
erin: and per-tenant kill-switch for private deployments (VPC) must not rely on central UI only. need an operator CLI and API that honors KMS permissions.
frank: ops concern: if fallback order includes hosted-fallback, make sure we account for cost metric and rate-limit fallback routing to avoid bill shock.
dave: also add trace context propagation so we can correlate requests that hit fallbacks with traces. makes debugging regressions easier.
alice: ownership: frank -> flag persistence design, erin -> admin UI + CLI, carla -> rollout schema + gating rules, ben -> runtime lookup & enforcement, grace -> fallback strategy + docs. I'll open follow-up PRs and a tracking issue (RFC#1287-post). Schedule: sync Fri 11am to approve schema. :calendar: :shipit:
ben: sg, I'll prototype runtime lookup today and post early test logs. :eyes:
carla: will draft gating examples for long-tail seqs.
frank: I'll spike Redis + config-service hybrid and share perf numbers.
erin: I'll add audit log requirements to compliance doc and ping security.
devops-bot: canary -> runtime-canary-us-west now at 10% traffic for attention-opt-v2
grace: noted. adding docs stub to /docs/runtime/rollouts.md :memo: :fire:
alice: thanks all — keep updates in this thread. closing loop after Fri sync. "
